option.name: --accept-server-license-terms
tip: Accept the server license terms

option.name: --cli-data-dir
tip: Directory for CLI data

option.name: --connection
tip: Set the connection token

option.name: --force
tip: Accept the tunnel even if another tunnel is running

option.name: --host
tip: The host name to listen on

option.name: --labels
tip: Comma separated list of labels

option.name: --name
tip: A name for the tunnel

option.name: --port
tip: The port to listen on

option.name: --add
tip: Add folder(s) to the last active window.

option.name: --agents
tip: Opens the agents window.

option.name: --diff
tip: Compare two files with each other.

option.name: --goto
tip: Open a file at the path on the specified line and character position.

option.name: --locale
tip: The locale to use (e.g. en-US or zh-TW).

option.name: --merge
tip: Perform a three-way merge.

option.name: --new-window
tip: Force to open a new window.

option.name: --profile
tip: Opens the provided folder or workspace with the given profile.

option.name: --remove
tip: Remove folder(s) from the last active window.

option.name: --reuse-window
tip: Force to open a file or folder in an already opened window.

option.name: --user-data-dir
tip: Specifies the directory that user data is kept in.

option.name: --version
tip: Print version.

option.name: --wait
tip: Wait for the files to be closed before returning.

global_option.name: --add-mcp
tip: Adds a Model Context Protocol server definition to the user profile.

global_option.name: --category
tip: Filters installed extensions by provided category, when using --list-extensions.

global_option.name: --disable-chromium-sandbox
tip: Use this option only when there is requirement to launch the application as sudo user on Linux or when running as an elevated user in an applocker environment on Windows.

global_option.name: --disable-extension
tip: Disable the provided extension.

global_option.name: --disable-extensions
tip: Disable all installed extensions.

global_option.name: --disable-gpu
tip: Disable GPU hardware acceleration.

global_option.name: --disable-lcd-text
tip: Disable LCD font rendering.

global_option.name: --enable-proposed-api
tip: Enables proposed API features for extensions.

global_option.name: --extensions-dir
tip: Set the root path for extensions.

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print usage.

global_option.name: --inspect-brk-extensions
tip: Allow debugging and profiling of extensions with the extension host being paused after start.

global_option.name: --inspect-extensions
tip: Allow debugging and profiling of extensions.

global_option.name: --install-extension
tip: Installs or updates an extension.

global_option.name: --list-extensions
tip: List the installed extensions.

global_option.name: --locate-shell-integration-path
tip: Print the path to a terminal shell integration script.

global_option.name: --log
tip: Log level to use.

global_option.name: --pre-release
tip: Installs the pre-release version of the extension, when using --install-extension.

global_option.name: --prof-startup
tip: Run CPU profiler during startup.

global_option.name: --show-versions
tip: Show versions of installed extensions, when using --list-extensions.

global_option.name: --status
tip: Print process usage and diagnostics information.

global_option.name: --sync
tip: Turn sync on or off.

global_option.name: --telemetry
tip: Shows all telemetry events which VS code collects.

global_option.name: --transient
tip: Run with temporary data and extension directories, as if launched for the first time.

global_option.name: --uninstall-extension
tip: Uninstalls an extension.

global_option.name: --update-extensions
tip: Update the installed extensions.

global_option.name: --verbose
tip: Print verbose output (implies --wait).
